author: Legoche
body:
http://youtu.be/umT-sQjU-Xo

He is clearly using aimbot as he is spinning around, and I originally though he was using force-field but then realized it was auto-clicker as he was breaking blocks around him. The video may not work for a bit as it is uploading, and it may be blurry for about 10-20 mins after upload.

(This may be lots of infractions as he has never had that punishment according to his profile)

Thanks for helping me with the issue,
Lego.
